visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a dark grey baseball cap and a woman in a pink 'emis' cap stand in a modern living room, holding a large pink cardboard promotional pack of Suntory Horoyoi beverages. The background features a simple apartment interior with an air conditioner and window. (2) The man points energetically toward the packaging while the woman holds up a single purple beverage can. Two small white blind boxes sit on the table in the foreground. (3) The woman begins unboxing one of the white boxes, revealing a bright green plush toy shaped like a beverage can. The plushie has tiny blue legs and embroidered facial features with the text 'White Grape' on it. (4) Close-up shots showcase the details of the green plushie, including its soft texture, the embroidery, and a small white plastic ring on top meant for hanging. (5) A rapid-fire editing sequence follows, showing the couple holding up different colored plushies: an orange/yellow one, a white one, and a pink one, all encased in clear plastic bags. (6) The video concludes with the couple holding all five discovered plushies and the beverage cans, smiling and looking directly at the camera in a bright, well-lit environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male and female voice speak in Mandarin with high energy and rapid delivery. An upbeat electronic pop background track with a prominent synth beat plays continuously. The recording quality is clean with minimal room reverb. (2) A rustling sound of paper and plastic bags is heard as the woman unboxes an item. Her vocal pitch spikes with a loud exclamation of 'Wah!' indicating surprise and joy. (3) The audio enters a highly edited sequence where sharp 'Impact' sound effects punctuate each fast visual cut. The speakers repeat high-arousal phrases about finding the 'hidden' items, while the music remains steady. (4) The voices maintain a high volume and fast pace until the very end, concluding with a call to action. The BGM maintains its energy throughout the entire sequence without fading until the final second.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Introduction -> Unboxing Process -> Conclusion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share the excitement of unboxing a limited-edition Suntory Horoyoi blind box set featuring beverage-themed plush toys. It serves to inform the audience about the product's price, availability in convenience stores, and to showcase the variety and quality of the collectibles.
